crossRefs.note: How do we hear, everyone in our own native language?

translations.web: How do we hear, everyone in our own native language?
translations.bsb: How is it then that each of us hears them in his own native language?
translations.kjv: And how hear we every man in our own tongue, wherein we were born?
translations.asv: And how hear we, every man in our own language wherein we were born?
